$comment: Project-level Claude Code settings. Hooks here run only when working in this repo. Edit with care — these are deliberate guardrails to keep AI changes from drifting.

hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const c=i.tool_input?.content||'';const fp=i.tool_input?.file_path||'';if(!/\\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs)$/.test(fp))process.exit(0);const lines=c.split('\n').length;if(lines>600){console.error('[hook] BLOCKED: '+fp+' is '+lines+' lines. Project rule: split files at ~300, hard cap 600. See CLAUDE.md §5.');process.exit(2)}if(lines>400){console.error('[hook] WARNING: '+fp+' is '+lines+' lines (soft cap 400). Consider splitting before it grows further.')}}catch(e){}process.exit(0)})"
